story_facts_verified.measure: FHFA House Price Index, All-Transactions version: a repeat-sales index (same homes over time) that adds refinance appraisals to purchase transactions. Not a median sale price; not seasonally adjusted; lags roughly one quarter.
story_facts_verified.columbus_series: ATNHPIUS18140Q (Columbus, OH MSA), units 'Index 1995:Q1=100, NSA'. Quarterly values pulled Oct. 3, 2026: 2024 Q1 312.60, Q2 325.41, Q3 327.08, Q4 330.36; 2025 Q1 334.14, Q2 339.78, Q3 341.06, Q4 342.87; 2026 Q1 346.10, Q2 351.14. Latest observation 2026 Q2, updated Aug. 25, 2026; next scheduled FRED update Oct. 27, 2026.
story_facts_verified.national_series: USSTHPI (United States), units 'Index 1980:Q1=100, NSA'. Values: 2025 Q2 698.69, Q3 703.04, Q4 707.22; 2026 Q1 712.20, Q2 719.87. Different base period from the Columbus series, so only rates of change are comparable.
story_facts_verified.release_schedule: FHFA's House Price Index page lists the next quarterly release as Nov. 24, 2026, covering 2026 Q3 (July-September). That is the article's next verifiable checkpoint.
story_facts_verified.original_contributions: Reproducible QoQ and YoY calculations from the raw series; a historical baseline comparison (this year's 3.3% vs last year's 4.4% pace); a Columbus-vs-national comparison; and a CREN line chart built from the public series.
story_facts_verified.limitations_stated: Index is not a median sale price and not the cost of a typical home today; NSA and lagged; Columbus and national series use different base periods (levels not directly comparable, only rates of change); and both series come from the same agency, so they are one measure of prices rather than two independent gauges.
